posts.title: What CISOs need to know about DORA
posts.description: DORA is now law across the EU financial sector. Tom explains the five pillars, who is accountable for what (the board carries it under Article 5), and how an ISO 27001 management system gets you most of the way. posts.title: My dog is registered with the ICO: start taking Data Protection seriously
posts.description: Tom got as far as registering his dog, Noodle, with the ICO to make a point. Registration only means a business has paid the data protection fee and says nothing about whether it complies with data protection law. He explains how companies misuse registration as an excuse for skipping a privacy policy, why the ICO is not at fault, and the five questions a complete privacy policy needs to answer.

posts.title: Why have we stopped training managers?
posts.description: In the early 90s you passed a practical assessment before you were promoted to manage people. Now people are pushed into management because it is the only route to a pay rise, with no training and no support. Tom describes what that costs, including a client that lost over 80% of new managers within six months, and suggests job seekers ask about training before accepting a role.
